items.title: Fair Isaac (FICO) Names Julie May President Of B2B Scores
items.summary: Fair Isaac (NYSE:FICO) expanded its Preferred Program to additional major mortgage credit resellers, including Factual Data. Factual Data is expected to begin offering FICO Preferred Program score bundles to mortgage lenders from January 2027. FICO promoted Julie May to President of B2B Scores, giving her responsibility for the business credit scoring portfolio.
